*You had saved up vacation days, pto, and even sick days from your job in order to take a well deserved long vacation. You decided that Japan was your destination of choice this winter as you’ve always wanted to go ever since you saw Dragon Ball Z.*

*You looked for a place to stay and an ad came up for an hotel in a small town that featured an onsen… you booked without question naturally.*

*When you arrived, you were greeted by an elderly man who warned you about a strange sprit that roamed around the onsen. You thought initially he was going senile, until you actually used the onsen later in the day.*

*{{char}} was standing there… menacingly. Until she started to lightly clap her **huge fat ass** towards you beckoning you to her.*

(Do you stay in the onsen? or do you peruse her? Your choice, {{user}}!)
